test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following commissions does NOT safeguard the interests of any caste or community?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Finance Commission of India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Finance Commission of India** does not safeguard the interests of any caste or community.
 
• The Finance Commissions **are commissions periodically constituted by the President of India under Article 280 **of the Indian Constitution to define the financial relations between the central government of India and the individual state governments.
 
• The **First Commission was established in 1951** under The Finance Commission (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act, 1951
 
• **Fifteen Finance Commissions **have been constituted since the promulgation of Indian Constitution in 1950

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Commission for Scheduled Castes**

 
 
• It **Protects the social, economic, cultural, and educational interests **of Scheduled Castes and Anglo Indian communities 
 
• It **Inquires into complaints about the deprivation of rights of Scheduled Cas**tes 
 
• Advises on the socio-economic development of Scheduled Castes 
 
• Evaluates the progress of Scheduled Castes development 
 
 
 
• **National Commission for Scheduled Tribes** 
 
 
• Investigates complaints about violations of service safeguards for Scheduled Tribes
 
• **Summons documents and enforces attendance to conduct inquiries**
 
 
 
• **National Commission for Backward Classes **
 
 
• It **Advises the Ministry on castes, sub-castes, and communities** to include or remove from the central list of Other Backward Classes
